entries.title: Anno 1602
entries.definitive_edition: Anno 1602 History Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native History Edition; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The History Edition is the modern Windows PC route, includes the New Islands, New Adventure expansion, and adds current-PC optimization, 4K support, save compatibility, and improved multiplayer.
primary.how_to_play: Play Anno 1602 History Edition on Windows PC through Ubisoft Connect or Steam.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Windows PC release, superseded for modern play by the 2020 History Edition with 4K/current-PC support.
all_releases.reason: primary: only platform, and the History Edition is the most complete modern route because it includes the expansion.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The modern History Edition improves fidelity and includes the expansion content.

entries.remaster_caveats: History Edition is a modernized PC reissue, not a remake; use it for compatibility and included expansion content.

entries.title: Anno 1701: Dawn of Discovery
entries.definitive_edition: Anno 1701: Dawn of Discovery on Nintendo DS

emulation.notes: Use original hardware when possible; DS emulation is the preservation route for capture.

primary.why: This is a distinct Nintendo DS spin-off with touch-screen controls; the Nintendo DS release is the only sourced platform.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original Nintendo DS cartridge on DS/3DS hardware, or preserve with a DS emulator such as melonDS when using legally dumped media.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Nintendo DS touch-screen release.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release platform for this spin-off.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: There is no platform choice for this spin-off beyond the Nintendo DS release.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a separate DS spin-off, not Anno 1701 History Edition and not Anno: Create a New World/Dawn of Discovery from 2009.

entries.title: Anno: Create a New World
entries.definitive_edition: Anno: Create a New World on Wii

emulation.notes: Use original Wii hardware when possible; Dolphin is the practical preservation/capture route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Wii presentation with emulator scaling where appropriate.

primary.why: This is a distinct Wii/Nintendo DS spin-off. The Wii version is the better capture route and highest-fidelity public release; no sourced exclusive DS content was found.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original Wii disc on Wii/Wii U hardware, or preserve with Dolphin when using legally dumped media. Use the DS release only if handheld/touch play is preferred.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Wii release with TV output and better capture path.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity route for this spin-off.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Nintendo DS handheld release.
all_releases.reason: skip: valid handheld route, but no sourced exclusive content over Wii was found.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Wii release provides the better capture/fidelity route, and no DS-exclusive content is known that would require a secondary playthrough.

entries.remaster_caveats: Known as Dawn of Discovery in North America; do not conflate it with Anno 1404, which also used the Dawn of Discovery title in North America.

entries.title: Anno 2070
entries.definitive_edition: Anno 2070 Complete Edition/current patched Windows PC release

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Complete Edition / current patched PC release
primary.why: Anno 2070 is a Windows PC-only mainline entry. The complete/current PC route is preferred because Deep Ocean adds major gameplay content, with a 2022 current patch path across Ubisoft Connect, Steam, and Epic.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Ubisoft Connect, Steam, or Epic, with Deep Ocean/Complete Edition content when available.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with complete/current patched routes.
all_releases.reason: primary: only platform and the complete route includes the Deep Ocean expansion.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: There is no platform split; the current Windows PC complete route is both highest-fidelity and most complete.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use a current patched install because Ubisoft changed legacy online/DRM behavior over time; this is not a History Edition remaster.

entries.title: Anno Online
entries.definitive_edition: No official playable version; original web browser service archived

emulation.notes: Server-side browser game; no standard emulator route preserves the official live service.

primary.why: Anno Online was a browser spin-off, and the official online service was shut down on January 31, 2018. The browser release is the only historical platform to document.
primary.how_to_play: No official playable route remains; this is an archive entry for a discontinued browser live-service game.

all_releases.fidelity: Original browser live-service release; no longer officially playable after shutdown.
all_releases.reason: primary: only historical platform.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: There is no current official version to choose; the original browser service is defunct.

entries.remaster_caveats: Online service was decommissioned on January 31, 2018, so this cannot be recommended as a playable current route.

entries.title: Anno 1800
entries.definitive_edition: Anno 1800 Definitive Annoversary Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC Definitive Annoversary Edition is the most complete and highest-fidelity route, including the base game, all four Season Passes, all cosmetic DLC, and the Deluxe Pack. Console Edition is a strong port, but there is content that is not available for Console Edition.
primary.how_to_play: Play Anno 1800 Definitive Annoversary Edition on Windows PC through Ubisoft Connect, Steam, or Epic. Use PS5 or Xbox Series X/S only if a console route is preferred.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with the complete Definitive Annoversary Edition route.
all_releases.reason: primary: all-DLC complete route and best capture/settings option.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PS5 Console Edition.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route, but not the most complete route because PC has the full Definitive Annoversary/DLC path and Ubisoft marks some content unavailable for Console Edition.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Xbox Series X/S Console Edition.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route, but not the most complete route because PC has the full Definitive Annoversary/DLC path and Ubisoft marks some content unavailable for Console Edition.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PC route is both the most complete and the best capture/settings route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console Edition is not a separate game entry; it is a console port with a different content path from the PC Definitive Annoversary Edition.
